name: FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv-fp8
notes: KV-cache accelerated variant of Klein 9B. 65.7K downloads vs 44.9K for non-KV. Drop-in checkpoint swap for all build_klein_* methods. Apache 2.0.

name: FLUX.2-small-decoder
notes: Compact high-fidelity VAE decoder for Klein pipelines. 194K downloads. Reduces decode-step VRAM. Drop-in to VAE folder. Apache 2.0.

name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
notes: 8.3B vs original 13B. 75% faster via SSTA attention. 14 GB VRAM minimum — fits 16 GB. ComfyUI native support refreshed June 5, 2026. Apache 2.0.

name: SAM 3.1 Multiplex (native ComfyUI)
notes: Native ComfyUI support merged (PR #13408). sam3.1_multiplex_fp16 adds shared-memory multi-object tracking. Faster than base SAM3. Native nodes: SAM3_Detect, SAM3_VideoTrack, SAM3_TrackToMask. SAM License.

name: Depth Anything 3 (DA3)
notes: VERIFY: confirm build_depth_map_v3 loads DA3 not Depth Anything V2. DA3-Streaming supports ultra-long video under 12 GB VRAM. Outperforms VGGT by 35.7% on camera-pose benchmarks. ComfyUI node: ComfyUI-DepthAnythingV3.

name: LTX-2.3
notes: 22B DiT. Major upgrade: 4K@50fps, stereo 24kHz audio, 9:16 portrait, new VAE, built-in spatial+temporal latent upscalers. FP8 at 16 GB. Day-0 ComfyUI support via Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo. Permissive license. Built-in upscalers reduce need for external seedvr2 step.

method: build_wan_video, build_wan22_t2v, build_wan_flf, build_wan_animate_video, build_wan_video_blockswap, build_wan_video_blockswap_t2v
name: Wan 2.7
notes: 27B/14B active MoE. Replaces all 6 WAN builders. 5 task types: T2V, I2V, 3x3-grid-I2V, reference-video, instruction-edit. Apache 2.0. Open weights HuggingFace. ComfyUI Partner Nodes (v0.18.5+). FP8+blockswap ~16 GB at 720p. Full reference-video mode may spike higher — test on target HW. Note: WAN 2.7 min practical VRAM listed as 24 GB in some sources; T2V/I2V modes more feasible.

name: HiDream-O1-Image FP8 Dev
notes: 8B pixel-native UiT — no external VAE or CLIP/T5. FP8 Dev ~10 GB VRAM. ComfyUI v0.22.0 native + Saganaki22/HiDream_O1-ComfyUI node. Claims to outperform FLUX.2 (56B) on quality-per-parameter benchmarks. New pipeline architecture — needs new build_hidream_txt2img builder, not a drop-in to existing flux path.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution (Comfy-Org official)
notes: Hardware-accelerated 4K upscaling via RTX tensor cores. 30x faster than ESRGAN for upscaling step. Official Comfy-Org maintained. No weights — closed NVIDIA algorithm. RTX 5060 Ti compatible. Complements existing upscalers rather than replacing them.

name: facerestore_advanced
notes: Smart wrapper around existing CodeFormer/GFPGAN weights. Adds SSIM + artifact detection + color bleeding analysis, skin texture analysis, facial landmark preservation, multi-model fallback, intelligent caching. No new weights needed. Drop-in quality upgrade.

name: RealRestorer
notes: 9 degradation types: blur, rain, reflection, low-light, denoising, haze, moire, flare, artifact repair. ComfyUI node: StartHua/Comfyui_RealRestorer. Lighter than SUPIR. Additive — SUPIR remains better for generative upscaling; RealRestorer better for real-world mixed degradations.

name: ComfyUI-Darkroom
notes: 46 nodes, 161 film stocks from real Capture One curves, 102 lens profiles, physics H&D curves, grain, halation, CMYK print workflow. No ML inference — zero VRAM cost. Substantially extends build_lut capability. Additive only.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video (IC-LoRA for LTX-2.3)
notes: IC-LoRA for LTX-2.3 enabling video face/head swap. Extends klein_headswap to video domain. Requires ComfyUI-BFSNodes node pack. 16 GB borderline — short clips ≤5s at 512px feasible. V3 Focus Head is recommended variant. License: other — review before deployment. Canonical upstream: SSBOfficial/BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video (May 25).

name: Code2Collapse ComfyUI-CustomNodePacks
notes: 72-node VFX suite. Includes SAM3 segmentation, temporal anchors, video mask propagation, EXR I/O, alpha matting. Improves per-frame mask quality for build_video_reactor. Released May 27, 2026 — within 7-day window.

name: NormalCrafter (ComfyUI-NormalCrafterWrapper)
notes: Temporally consistent normal map sequences from video using video diffusion priors. Sliding-window (size=14). Additive to existing build_normal_map for video use cases.

name: Hunyuan3D 2.5 / LATTICE
notes: PAPER ONLY — no confirmed public weights as of 2026-06-06. 10B shape model (LATTICE) + PBR multi-view texture pipeline. Shape-only ~10 GB VRAM (feasible); texture needs ~21 GB (not feasible without tiled inference). Monitor tencent/Hunyuan3D-2 HF repo for weight release.

name: Z-Image-Base (Alibaba 6B S3-DiT)
notes: 6B S3-DiT. BF16 fits 16 GB. Native ComfyUI workflow at docs.comfy.org. SDXL replacement candidate. New architecture requires new loader nodes (already in ComfyUI). Apache 2.0. Evaluate when SDXL phase-out is planned.

name: Qwen-Image 2.0 + InstantX ControlNet
notes: VERIFY: confirm build_qwen_edit checkpoint version. If pre-2.0, update to Feb 2026 release. InstantX ControlNet variant adds canny/depth/inpaint modes. 20B MMDiT needs GGUF quantization for 16 GB. Apache 2.0.

name: Hunyuan3D-Omni
notes: 3.3B unified text/image/multimodal 3D generation. ~10 GB VRAM — feasible. No ComfyUI node confirmed. HF mirror forks appeared in window (Antided/Hunyuan3D-Omni, May 2026). Low priority until node appears.

name: LongCat-Video (Meituan 13.6B)
notes: 13.6B DiT. MIT license. Minute-scale video without drift. FP8 targets 12-16 GB; BF16 needs 24 GB. Community conversion Kijai/LongCat-Video_comfy. No official ComfyUI node. Watch for PR resolution.

name: OSDFace (CVPR 2025, one-step diffusion)
notes: Single-step diffusion face restoration. ~0.1s inference for 512x512. Surpasses CodeFormer on quality+identity metrics. No ComfyUI node yet. Watch for community port.

name: InstantRestore (Snap Research, SIGGRAPH 2025)
notes: Single-step personalized face restoration using 4 reference images. Superior identity preservation vs multi-step methods. Near-real-time. No ComfyUI node. SIGGRAPH 2025 publication.

name: ilkerzgi/face-swap (FLUX.2-Klein 9B LoRA)
notes: 12,500+ downloads. LoRA for FLUX.2-Klein 9B for face/head swapping. High community traction. License listed as 'other' — MUST review before deployment. Standard Klein LoRA loading should work.

name: FLUX.1 Kontext Dev (maturity check)
notes: Already registered as flux_kontext (experimental) in architectures.py. FP8 quantized now runs on 7 GB. ComfyUI v0.3.42 required. Consider removing experimental flag if node support is confirmed stable. 12B params, non-commercial license.
